messages.subject: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Hi,

Is the 1-tonne mini dumper available for rental? I'd be picking up from Kempele. Haven't decided exact dates yet but looking at sometime next week probably.

Teemu Alatalo

messages.subject: Re: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Thanks for getting in touch. I'll check availability at the Kempele depot and let you know.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Thanks Marko. While I'm at it, could you also send me a copy of my invoice? I need it for some paperwork I'm sorting out.

Teemu

messages.subject: Re: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Hi Teemu,

Sure, happy to help with that. Which invoice do you mean? We have several on your account so just let me know the rental or the approximate date and I'll find it.

Jussi Kärnä
Rental Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Also need to sort out bringing back the compact track loader. What times can I drop it off at Kempele this week?

Teemu

messages.subject: Re: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Teemu,

Noted. I'll check the return schedule at Kempele and get back to you with available times.

Jussi

messages.subject: Re: Mini dumper availability
messages.body:
Jussi, I'd also like to book the cement mixer trailer again, same as my last rental. Sometime in the next couple of weeks would work.

Teemu

messages.subject: Scissor lift invoice query
messages.body:
Good afternoon,

We received the invoice for the 10m scissor lift rental and had a question about the billing. Could someone take a look and get back to us? We'd like to get it cleared up before we process the payment.

Regards,
Meri-Lapin Maansiirto Oy

messages.subject: Delivery options - scaffold tower
messages.body:
Morning,

Looking at renting a 6m scaffold tower. Do you deliver to residential addresses in Oulu, or would I need to come pick it up myself? Just trying to figure out the logistics.

Ville Junttila

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - scaffold tower
messages.body:
Hi Ville,

Thanks for your enquiry. We do deliver in the Oulu area. I'll look into the options for the scaffold tower and send you the details.

Kind regards,
Hanna-Kaisa Louhi
Rental Coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Delivery options - scaffold tower
messages.body:
Hi Hanna-Kaisa,

One more thing. Would the same delivery arrangements work for a 20kVA diesel generator? I might need one as well for a project I've got coming up.

Ville

messages.subject: Compact track loader booking
messages.body:
Hello,

We'd like to book the compact track loader again, same as our previous rental. Could you check availability and send us a quote when you can.

Kiinteistöhuolto Ahola Oy

messages.subject: Question about my invoice
messages.body:
Hi there,

I wanted to ask about the invoice for the compact track loader rental. Could you give me a ring or drop me a line when you get a chance?

Jari Peltoniemi

messages.subject: Equipment fault - no adjustment received
messages.body:
We need to address the situation with the unit that was out of service for two full days during our rental due to an equipment fault. Your technician confirmed the problem was on your end. Despite this, we have not received any adjustment or credit on our bill.

Your own rental conditions say downtime from confirmed equipment defects should be compensated. We have been renting from Haapaharju since 2022 with no issues, and frankly we expected better.

Please get back to us on this as soon as possible.

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy
